summary: Pre-deployment regression for Fork·Fate (mobile 390x844 + backend smoke). All 9 requested checks PASS. Realm dialog appears on first visit (ff_theme_chosen gate) with 12 realm tiles. Guided intro skip works. Deal flow: ZIP 10001 -> Food -> spin-roulette-button -> spin-result-card + respin-button + reveal-photo-header appear; fates counter incremented from 1,940 to 1,941. Theme switching persists (ff_theme=tiki confirmed; ambiance-scene-tiki mounts). Cyber saucer: layer (position:fixed, z-index:30, visibility:visible), saucer, saucer-beam, saucer-beacon all present; transform changes over 700ms so animation is running. Saucer abduction: ff:abduct event mounts data-testid='cyber-abduction' within 800ms and unmounts by ~7s; header logo remains visible; saucer-layer visibility returns to 'visible'. Streak badge shows '4 day streak' after seeding ff_streak. Language toggle: data-testid='lang-es'/'lang-en' persists ff_lang=es/en in localStorage. Sponsor dialog opens (mobile-sponsor-button). Favorites drawer opens (open-favorites-button, shows 'Saved spots'). Backend: /api/stats/fates=1940, /api/stats/crawls=0, /api/sponsors/active returns 2 seeded sponsors (E2E Test Diner, Burrito Bandito), POST /api/places/search with zip 10001 returns 200 with restaurants (source=curated). SHUFFLE_LOOPS code review (Home.jsx L52-63) confirms cyber=0.5, winter=0.65, fall=0.55; second play site at L681-682 reads via optional chaining SHUFFLE_LOOPS[theme]?.[0]/[1] — safe for dark theme (no crash). No pageerrors or console errors captured across any flow.
verified_flows: Home loads, no console errors, first-visit realm dialog (data-testid='theme-welcome') with theme-welcome-option-* tiles renders correctly.
Deal flow (light theme): ZIP -> Food -> Deal (data-testid='spin-roulette-button') -> spin-result-card revealed with reveal-photo-header; counter 1,940 -> 1,941.
Theme switching persists to ff_theme; ambiance-scene-cyber/tiki mounts per theme.
Cyber saucer under fixed z-30 cyber-saucer-layer contains saucer, saucer-beam, saucer-beacon; transform animates over time.
Abduction easter egg via window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ff:abduct')): cyber-abduction mounts ~<1s, unmounts by ~7s, logo remains visible, layer visibility returns to visible.
Streak badge renders '4 day streak' after seeding ff_streak {count:4, date:now}.
Backend /api/stats/fates, /api/stats/crawls, /api/sponsors/active, POST /api/places/search all 200; sponsors include E2E Test Diner + Burrito Bandito as expected.
SHUFFLE_LOOPS volumes match spec (cyber 0.5, winter 0.65, fall 0.55); L681-682 uses optional chaining, safe for themes with no loop (dark/fantasy/etc.).
Favorites drawer opens via open-favorites-button; sponsor dialog opens via mobile-sponsor-button; language toggle persists ff_lang.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is 1497 lines — long-standing recommendation to extract deal/reveal/ritual handlers into hooks for maintainability (repeat of iter55 comment).
No new critical issues detected for this deploy.
